notes: Design inferred (registry-based trend analysis; none named). The t-test of APC is a test of a model slope and could be read as part of the joinpoint model; the AAPC z-test tests a derived quantity. Comparisons across race and age rest on each group's APC tested against zero; no test compares trends between groups. 'Weighted average' for AAPC is arithmetic, not survey weighting.
view_issues: Table note says only overall rates were age-adjusted, while Figure 1 shows modeled age-adjusted rates by race, so it is unclear whether race-specific rates are age-adjusted. Footnote §§ mentions death rates, which are not analyzed. Article was corrected after publication (erratum 2022-01-28).
